plan.goal: Generate and rank a compact de novo protein-design workflow that yields one final small candidate with sequence, predicted structure evidence, and basic QC.
assumptions: An unconditional de novo backbone is acceptable as the starting scaffold for a compact soluble design workflow.
Single-sequence inverse folding followed by sequence-to-structure prediction provides sufficient preliminary evidence for triage.
Solubility and developability are assessed heuristically through sequence/structure QC metrics rather than an explicit solubility-optimization tool.
The workflow may produce intermediate candidates upstream, but final ranking will retain only one top candidate.
